issues.claim: PlayOn violated the CCPA's prohibition on selling or sharing personal information of consumers aged 13-16 without affirmative opt-in consent
issues.issue: Round 1 critical issue. Researcher revised to clarify the settlement requires future compliance but the decision did not make a specific finding of a minor-specific violation. Multiple independent sources (Loeb & Loeb, Inside Privacy, CPPA press release) confirm the revised language is accurate.

issues.claim: PlayOn's privacy notice had not been updated since July 2022 — over two and a half years
issues.issue: Round 1 major issue. Researcher revised to specify July 2022 and 'over two and a half years.' Independent search confirms privacy policy was last updated July 2022. The duration characterization is accurate for the violation period (July 2022 to December 2024 endpoint).

issues.claim: the CPPA ruled this does not satisfy CCPA requirements under Cal. Civ. Code Section 1798.120 and Section 1798.135
issues.issue: Round 1 minor issue. Researcher updated to reference both Section 1798.120 (consumer right to opt out of sale/sharing) and Section 1798.135 (business opt-out mechanism obligations) with correct URLs for each. Independent verification confirms Section 1798.120 covers consumer opt-out rights and Section 1798.135 covers business obligations. Both are relevant to the NAI/DAA opt-out deficiency finding.

The Loeb & Loeb URL used in the report (/en/insights/publications/2026/03/calprivacy-playon-sports-enforcement) does not match the URL found via independent web search (/en/insights/passle/2026/03/california-privacy-protection-agency-issues-first-decision-involving-violation-of-ccpa-and-minor-stu). The report URL uses the '/publications/' path while the actual article appears to be under '/passle/' with a different slug. The report URL may be a broken link. Unable to verify via WebFetch (tool unavailable) but the content attribution to Loeb & Loeb is substantively correct based on search results confirming Loeb & Loeb published analysis of the PlayOn enforcement action.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the Loeb & Loeb URL in both the Key Facts inline citation and the Sources section to: https://www.loeb.com/en/insights/passle/2026/03/california-privacy-protection-agency-issues-first-decision-involving-violation-of-ccpa-and-minor-stu
